questions.questionText: Consider the following $C$ function definition int Trial (int a, int b, int c) { if ((a>=b) && (c<b)) return b; else if (a>=b) return Trial(a, c, b); else return Trial(b, a, c); } The functional Trial: Finds the maximum of $a$, $b$, and $c$ Finds the minimum of $a$, $b$, and $c$ Finds the middle number of $a$, $b$, $c$ None of the above
questions.questionHtml:
Consider the following $C$ function definition

int Trial (int a, int b, int c)
{
    if ((a>=b) && (c<b)) return b;
    else if (a>=b) return Trial(a, c, b);
    else return Trial(b, a, c);
}

The functional Trial:

  1. Finds the maximum of $a$, $b$, and $c$

  2. Finds the minimum of $a$, $b$, and $c$

  3. Finds the middle number of $a$, $b$, $c$

  4. None of the above
